# Superpowers

This workspace includes the Superpowers skills from https://github.com/obra/superpowers in `.github/skills/`.

Use the relevant skill before acting on development tasks. In particular, use `brainstorming` for new features, `writing-plans` for approved implementation plans, `test-driven-development` while implementing code, and `verification-before-completion` before reporting completion.

Project-specific workflow artifacts are stored in `.superpowers/sdd/` and `docs/superpowers/`.
